answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an AI economy can use cryptographic proof-of-stake tied to rare digital assets. Agents must lock tokens sourced from a fixed-supply digital ocean to participate. If a malicious cluster tries flooding the network like a rogue river, validators trace the activity along a shared trust ridge and slash the staked collateral. This makes creating fake identities cost prohibitive, forcing attackers to burn massive financial capital for zero network control.
